github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text:
Generate exactly ONE commit message for the entire supplied diff, not a list of separate commits. Format: one scoped Conventional Commit title, then one blank line, then a concise body of ordinary '- ' bullet points. The title must be type(scope): imperative summary, with a meaningful scope covering the overall change (for example admin, residents, pagination, forms, auth, or ops). Choose the title's scope and summary based on the primary application code or behavior change; do not let documentation updates determine the title when code changes are also present. Mention documentation changes only as a secondary body bullet when useful, and use a docs scope/title only when the diff is documentation-only. Never use an unscoped title such as feat: or fix:. Only the first line may have a Conventional Commit prefix; body bullets must be plain descriptions, never additional feat(...):, docs(...):, fix(...): or test(...): titles. Do not output alternatives, headings, explanations or code fences. Describe the actual diff; do not claim changes or verification not present in the context. Example format:
feat(admin): refine resident table controls

- Add registration source sorting and filtering
- Update related guidance and regression tests
